Scientific Calculator

Evaluate expressions with trig, logs, powers and factorials.

–
Result

    % is percentage (divides by 100). n! needs a non-negative integer.

    📖 How to use

    1. Type an expression or tap the pad buttons to build it, e.g. sin(30)+2^3.
    2. Switch between DEG and RAD for the trig functions.
    3. Press = or Enter to evaluate; everything runs locally in your browser.
    4. See past calculations in the history list below the result.

    ❓ Frequently asked questions

    How is the expression evaluated?

    With a hand-written tokenizer, shunting-yard parser and RPN evaluator — eval() is never used, so arbitrary code cannot run.

    What does the % key do?

    It is a percentage: it divides the preceding value by 100. It is not the modulo operator.

    Why did sin(30) give 0.5?

    The calculator defaults to degrees (DEG). Tap the DEG button to switch to radians if you need radian mode.
